visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long reddish-brown hair, wearing a white cardigan and blue baggy jeans, stands on a grey gravel path lined with lush green cypress trees. She waves and gestures toward the scenery. (2) She walks toward the camera along the tree-lined path; a beige camping tarp and dark tents are visible in the background under the bright natural daylight. (3) The camera captures her from behind as she walks deeper into the dense green forest, highlighting the verticality of the trees. (4) Back to a frontal view, she gestures upward at the low-hanging branches while speaking, surrounded by vibrant green foliage. (5) She approaches a small concrete utility building, opening a white door to reveal a clean, tiled bathroom area with a shower and neutral-colored wall tiles. (6) Close-up shots show the interior of a restroom with a white squat toilet, followed by another unit containing a seated toilet and urinal. (7) She stands near a sheltered area pointing out shared facilities including two large refrigerators and a table with hand-held hair dryers. (8) The final shot is a close-up of green needles against a bright, slightly overcast sky.
